raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be late"
  role subject "the user's train from York"
  role object "more than 30 minutes"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty supposed

@s2 stated
  relation "cost"
  role subject "the user's ticket"
  role object "£64"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty supposed

@q query
  where match
    relation "be able to claim Delay Repay"
    role subject "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?amount
  where match
    relation "get back"
    role subject "the user"
    role object ?amount
    polarity affirmed
  end
